令牌只用于你安装的浏览器扩展。不要粘贴到网页或发送给其他人。: Use this token only with browser extensions you installed. Do not paste it into a webpage or send it to anyone.
使用浏览器官方扩展，把网页归档和可检索正文保存到本机资料库。: Use official browser-store extensions to save page archives and searchable text to the local knowledge library.
先提取并预览，再确认保存。预览阶段不会修改资料库索引。: Extract and preview first, then confirm saving. Previewing does not change the knowledge-library index.
只会保存你确认的内容；搜索索引在本机建立。: Only confirmed content is saved, and the search index is built on this Mac.
当前地址是本机回环地址。内容只发送给此 Mac 上运行的模型服务，不需要第三方数: The current address is a local loopback endpoint. Content is sent only to the model service running on this Mac, so third-party data-sharing consent is not required.
当前版本支持 Safari、Chrome 和 Firefox。Safari We: This release supports Safari, Chrome, and Firefox. The Safari Web Extension is bundled with the app; Chrome and Firefox extensions are installed and updated separately.
撤销后，测试连接、AI 对话、写作建议和图片文案等功能都会停止发送请求，直到你再: After revocation, connection tests, AI chat, writing suggestions, image copy, and other AI features stop sending requests until you explicitly consent again.
智能集合根据作者、标签、来源、时间和检索权限自动更新，不会复制资料。: Smart collections update automatically by author, tag, source, time, and search permission without duplicating sources.
浏览器扩展可通过本机回环地址连接，连接令牌仍为必需。: Browser extensions can connect through the local loopback address. A pairing token is still required.
现有浏览器扩展会立即断开，需要粘贴新令牌后重新连接。: The current browser extensions will disconnect immediately. Paste the new token into each extension to reconnect.
组合集合会随作者、标签、来源和时间变化自动更新。: Combined collections update automatically when authors, tags, sources, or dates change.
